checks.falsifier: Any pinned path whose measured sha256 differs from its pin; the measurement is then void.
checks.name: all pinned inputs match at read time (T0)

checks.falsifier: A FROZEN declaration disagreeing with the measured bytes; then the freeze is stale, not this measurement.
checks.name: FROZEN revision 29 pins suite/F1/F0 exactly as measured

checks.falsifier: A duplicate mapping key in the reviewed bytes; the flat-path delta could then be an artefact of the loader.
checks.name: strict duplicate-key scan on both schema snapshots

checks.falsifier: The before-oracle snapshot not hashing to cce9c60146d6, or a leaf present in both trees whose canonical representation did not change and is listed anyway.
checks.name: rev12 snapshot -> rev13 live structural leaf delta

checks.falsifier: Any row whose binding_sha256 equals the live rev13 hash, or a binding that is neither the rev12 nor the rev13 hash.
checks.name: suite row binding vs the live rev13 pin

checks.falsifier: A rebind of all 25 rows to the live canonical pin, which makes this check pass.
checks.name: vendor hard check C1a input: canonical F1 sha256 == suite binding

checks.falsifier: A row listed as material whose deciding/probe path has no ancestor/descendant relation to any changed leaf, or a changed path exercised by a row that is not listed.
checks.name: per-row materiality of the rev12->rev13 delta

checks.falsifier: A stored expectation that passes on the rev12 snapshot and fails on the rev13 bytes (that would make rev13 alone invalidating), or a stored expectation that fails at rev12 but passes at rev13.
checks.name: expectation validity across rev12 -> rev13

checks.falsifier: A declared cross-artifact hash equal to the measured bytes of its declared path at this pin.
checks.name: suite cross-artifact declarations resolve on disk

checks.falsifier: Any pinned path whose hash moved between the snapshot and the end of the run; the measurement is then superseded, not merely wrong.
checks.name: no input drift between T0 and T1 (emission-time binding)

controls.falsifier: The detector fails to relate an identical path to itself.
controls.name: planted change on a probed deciding path is detected as material

controls.falsifier: The ancestor/descendant relation matches unrelated paths.
controls.name: planted change on an unrelated path leaves materiality empty

controls.falsifier: equals() returning True for a value that differs from the expectation.
controls.name: a mutated expectation is detected as a recomputed failure

controls.falsifier: The leaf comparator reporting a difference for identical input.
controls.name: identical trees produce an empty delta

controls.falsifier: A metadata path being related to a content deciding field.
controls.name: metadata-only delta (revision/revision_history) does not create material rows

controls.falsifier: The rev12 recomputation not reproducing both F1-AMB-25 false probes.
controls.name: real rev12 control reproduces the known F1-AMB-25 false expectation set

controls.falsifier: evaluate() silently accepting an unknown probe kind.
controls.name: unknown probe kind fails closed

controls.falsifier: A duplicate key appearing in either snapshot.
controls.name: duplicate-key scan is armed on the reviewed bytes

falsifier: Re-run this checker on the same snapshot bytes: the adjudication is falsified if any listed material row has no ancestor/descendant relation to a changed leaf, if a stored expectation is shown to flip true->false at rev13 while passing at rev12, if the F1-AMB-25 pre-existing set is not reproduced from the third-party rev12 snapshot, or if any pin or control behaves differently.
